passages.note: House Third Reading roll call on SB1165 shows Bolick voting Y; this was during her 2019-2023 House term, before her current Senate seat.

passages.provision_quote: B. Athletic teams or sports designated for "females", "women" or "girls" may not be open to students of the male sex. C. This section does not restrict the eligibility of any student to participate in any interscholastic or intramural athletic team or sport designated as being for "males", "men" or "boys" or designated as "coed" or "mixed".
passages.note: Enacted text of SB1165 bars only female-designated teams to male-sex students while leaving male and coed teams open to all, matching rung 4's pattern per the annex.
Bill status page lists Bolick as a co-sponsor of SB1165 and records its House Third Reading passage and the Governor's signature.

rows.reasoning: Bolick co-sponsored and voted Yea (House Third Reading, 31-24-5-0-0) on SB 1165 (2022); its enacted text bars teams designated for "females, women or girls" to students of the male sex while leaving male- and coed-designated teams open to all, matching the rung text "require transgender athletes to compete only on teams matching their biological sex assigned at birth." Per the earlier-chamber-same-legislature rule, her 2019-2023 House record counts for her current Senate seat.
